verdict.rationale: The firm practices both Canadian and U.S. immigration, which makes Canada a plausible interim option. It describes the Canadian Start-Up Visa work-permit extensions and a J-1 university-incubator pathway that founders could use as an alternative route. Its materials do not frame any of these as fallbacks, though, and the only hint of post-denial help is a passing mention of 'complex litigation case[s]'. Missing for 10: guidance on running the company remotely while waiting, explicit discussion of interim or fallback strategy, what happens after a denial (appeals, refiling, motions), and any independent corroboration.
